review_comments.body: **Nested settings still disappear** `maps.Clone` copies only the outer map. With `web_search_options: []interface{}{map[string]interface{}{"search_type": "news"}}`, the converter still deletes `search_type` from the caller's nested map. A second conversion loses that setting. The same problem affects `user_location` and `media_response.overrides`. Clone those nested maps before editing them, and extend the repeated-conversion test to cover them. **Knowledge Base Used:** - [Provider adapters and model capabilities](https://app.greptile.com/maxim-ai/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/maximhq/bifrost/-/docs/provider-adapters.md) - [Restore provider-safe cache point handling](https://app.greptile.com/maxim-ai/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/maximhq/bifrost/-/reverts/rollback_7182-20260922-cachepoint-fallback-8c719d0.md)

**Image test misses the bug** This test passes with the old code too: `hfInference` never consumes the only supplied key, `custom`. It cannot catch a return of the caller-map mutation bug. Add cases for branches that delete mapped keys, such as `falAI` with `guidance_scale` and image edits with `use_image_urls`. Check that the caller keeps those keys, the typed fields are filled, and a second conversion gives the same result.

**Tests break the required layout** `AGENTS.md` requires adding tests to existing test files rather than creating a file for each bug. This PR adds `extraparams_test.go` in Cohere, HuggingFace, and Perplexity even though those packages already have tests. Move these cases into the existing test files before merging so related coverage stays together and the repository requirement is satisfied. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/e4a4a169d9e04dd2108ac25f7938987e8d2e0354/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Required speech coverage is missing** `AGENTS.md` requires a provider-harness case for changes a client can observe. This PR fixes speech requests without `Params`, but adds only Go tests and no harness case. Before merging, add a case that sends a speech request without optional parameters and checks the response through the HTTP route. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/e4a4a169d9e04dd2108ac25f7938987e8d2e0354/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

Summary

## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Perplexity, Cohere, and Hugging Face request conversions no longer alter caller-supplied extra parameters, including when requests are converted repeatedly. * Supported provider-specific parameters are mapped to their corresponding request fields, while unrecognized parameters remain available for forwarding. * Hugging Face speech requests with no extra parameters are handled without an error. * Hugging Face embedding, image-generation, and speech conversions preserve the original extra parameters. Perplexity, Cohere, and Hugging Face converters clone caller `ExtraParams` before extracting recognized values. Tests check that conversions preserve input maps and map recognized values to request fields. Hugging Face speech tests also cover requests without params. **Changes: Provider extra-parameter conversion** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Cohere request conversions**

Chat and responses also clone nested `thinking` maps. Tests check input-map preservation and parameter mapping.| |**Hugging Face request conversions**
`core/providers/huggingface/embedding.go`, `core/providers/huggingface/speech.go`, `core/providers/huggingface/images.go`, `core/providers/huggingface/extraparams_test.go`, `core/changelog.md`|Embedding, speech, and image converters clone `ExtraParams` before extracting values or assigning the map. Tests cover map preservation, parameter mapping, and speech requests without params. The changelog describes converter changes.| |**Perplexity chat conversion**
`core/providers/perplexity/chat.go`, `core/providers/perplexity/extraparams_test.go`|The chat converter clones `ExtraParams` before extracting recognized values. Tests check map preservation and repeated conversion. A benchmark is also added.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes
Merge Risk: Low · up to b26a8

The change stops converters from removing top-level mapped keys from the caller's ExtraParams. Perplexity's nested web search and media options are still consumed from the caller's maps. A retry or fallback that reuses the same request can therefore lose those nested values. The impact is narrow and the fix is small, so this is mergeable with the follow-up.
